meta.title: Готовое ПП-меню с доставкой по Алматы — O-live

overrides.text: Выберите дни и предпочтения (до 3) — мы автоматически заменим блюда в меню. Если замена дороже, разница в цене блюд добавится к заказу — вы увидите её сразу, ещё до оплаты.

props.content:
Доставка по Алматы каждый день

Питайся здорово

Рационы для снижения веса и баланса — КБЖУ уже посчитаны.

Собрать рацион Смотреть меню

<style class="gs-skin">
/* v7 skin band (design/SKIN_V7.md) — single owner of:
   1) the gs- design tokens (defined exactly once page-wide);
   2) shared skin primitives (.gs-sec/.gs-wrap/.gs-h2/.gs-lead/.gs-btn/.gs-imgbox/.gs-tag)
      consumed by the content sections — dropping this band unstyles them;
   3) the .gs-reveal scroll-in utility (script at the bottom of this band);
   4) site-chrome recolors to the donor palette (research/donor-v7.html) — the sf-/l- rules
      below are the same deliberate-chrome-layer class as 05-style rules 1-3; validate.py
      warns once, expected.
   LK round (2026-08-16): --gs7-muted darkened #697260 -> #4E5748 (5.03 -> 7.55 on white,
   7.2 on #F4F8EE) and body/lead sizes raised one step — the "more contrast, bigger text"
   pass. Other palette contrast (SKIN_V7 §1): white on #3F6B39 6.22 AA · white on #4E8046
   4.67 AA · #2C4E28 on #DCEBC4 7.51 AAA. Gold #E0A73C never carries white text (2.15)
   and is decorative-only on light. */
:root{
  --gs-sp-1:4px;--gs-sp-2:8px;--gs-sp-3:12px;--gs-sp-4:16px;--gs-sp-5:24px;
  --gs-sp-6:32px;--gs-sp-7:48px;--gs-sp-8:64px;
  --gs-r-btn:999px;--gs-r-input:12px;--gs-r-card:22px;--gs-r-big:26px;--gs-r-pill:999px;
  --gs-sh-card:0 14px 30px -18px rgba(32,39,26,.22);
  --gs-sh-raised:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(32,39,26,.35);
  --gs-sh-bar:0 -4px 20px rgba(32,39,26,.12);
  --gs-fs-hero:clamp(3.5rem,16vw,7rem);
  --gs-fs-h2:clamp(2.125rem,8vw,3.5rem);
  --gs-fs-h3:1.375rem;--gs-fs-lead:1.1875rem;--gs-fs-body:1.0625rem;--gs-fs-sm:.9375rem;--gs-fs-xs:.8125rem;
  --gs-display:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --gs-text:"Museo Sans Cyrl",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;
  --gs7-soft:#F4F8EE;--gs7-spring:#DCEBC4;--gs7-spring2:#C3DF9C;
  --gs7-green:#3F6B39;--gs7-green2:#4E8046;--gs7-deep:#2C4E28;
  --gs7-ink:#20271A;--gs7-muted:#4E5748;--gs7-gold:#E0A73C;--gs7-line:rgba(32,39,26,.14);
}
.gs-wrap{max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
.gs-sec{padding:56px 0;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.gs-sec--soft{background:var(--gs7-soft,#F4F8EE)}
.gs-center{text-align:center}
.gs-h2{margin:0 0 16px;font:800 var(--gs-fs-h2,2.125rem)/1.04 var(--gs-display,system-ui,sans-serif);
  letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--gs7-ink,#20271A);text-wrap:balance}
.gs-lead{margin:0;font:500 var(--gs-fs-lead,1.1875rem)/1.5 var(--gs-text,sans-serif);
  color:var(--gs7-muted,#4E5748);max-width:42ch}
.gs-center .gs-lead{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.gs-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;min-height:50px;
  padding:14px 26px;border-radius:var(--gs-r-pill,999px);background:var(--gs7-green,#3F6B39);
  color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font:700 1rem/1.05 var(--gs-text,sans-serif);
  box-shadow:0 12px 24px -12px var(--gs7-deep,#2C4E28);transition:background .15s,transform .15s}
.gs-btn:hover,.gs-btn:focus{background:var(--gs7-green2,#4E8046);color:#fff}
.gs-btn:active{transform:scale(.98)}
.gs-btn--big{min-height:58px;padding:18px 34px;font-size:1.0625rem}
.gs-btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--gs7-green,#3F6B39);
  border:1.5px solid var(--gs7-green,#3F6B39);box-shadow:none}
.gs-btn--ghost:hover,.gs-btn--ghost:focus{background:var(--gs7-soft,#F4F8EE);color:var(--gs7-deep,#2C4E28)}
.gs-imgbox{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#DCEBC4,#C3DF9C);
  display:grid;place-items:center}
.gs-imgbox::before{content:attr(data-emoji);font-size:46px;opacity:.85}
.gs-imgbox--photo::before{content:none}
.gs-tag{display:inline-block;background:var(--gs7-green,#3F6B39);color:#fff;
  font:800 var(--gs-fs-xs,.8125rem)/1.3 var(--gs-text,sans-serif);padding:6px 13px;
  border-radius:var(--gs-r-pill,999px)}

/* --- scroll-in reveal (the "fade in for components" pass) ---------------------
   Opt-in and JS-gated: the hidden state lives behind .gs-js, which the script at the
   bottom of this band sets only when requestAnimationFrame exists and the reader has not
   asked for reduced motion. Without JS or under prefers-reduced-motion the markup renders
   fully visible — a reveal utility must never be able to hide content. */
.gs-js .gs-reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px);
  transition:opacity .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.gs-js .gs-reveal.is-in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.gs-js .gs-reveal--d1{transition-delay:.08s}
.gs-js .gs-reveal--d2{transition-delay:.16s}
.gs-js .gs-reveal--d3{transition-delay:.24s}
.gs-js .gs-reveal--d4{transition-delay:.32s}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .gs-btn{transition:none}
  .gs-js .gs-reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}}
@media (min-width:1024px){.gs-sec{padding:92px 0}}
/* --- site chrome recolors (deliberate, same layer class as 05-style rules 1-3) --- */
.sf-green-btn--classic{background:#3F6B39;color:#fff;border-radius:999px}
.sf-green-btn--classic:hover{background:#4E8046;color:#fff}
.l-title{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:#20271A}
.l-title::after{display:none}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-button{font-weight:700;color:#20271A;font-size:1.0625rem}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-button:not(.collapsed){background:#DCEBC4;color:#2C4E28;box-shadow:none}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-button:focus{border-color:#3F6B39;box-shadow:0 0 0 .25rem rgba(63,107,57,.25)}
.sf-faq__accordion .accordion-body{color:#4E5748}
.sf-footer{background:#F4F8EE}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  if(!('requestAnimationFrame' in window))return;
  if(window.matchMedia&&window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)').matches)return;
  document.documentElement.classList.add('gs-js');
  /* Deliberately a scroll pass rather than IntersectionObserver: the page's CTAs are
     anchor jumps (#orderFunnel, #gsDishes), and a jump straight past a section moves it
     from below the viewport to above it without an intersecting frame — IO can miss that
     and leave the section stuck at opacity 0 forever. The rule here is "top is above the
     reveal line", which is also true for everything already scrolled past, so a jump can
     never hide content. The listener detaches once the last item has been revealed. */
  var items=null,ticking=false;
  function queue(){if(!ticking){ticking=true;window.requestAnimationFrame(pass);}}
  function detach(){window.removeEventListener('scroll',queue);window.removeEventListener('resize',queue);
    document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange',queue);}
  function pass(){
    ticking=false;
    var line=(window.innerHeight||document.documentElement.clientHeight)*0.94,left=[];
    for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++){
      if(items[i].getBoundingClientRect().top<line)items[i].classList.add('is-in');
      else left.push(items[i]);
    }
    items=left;
    if(!items.length)detach();
  }
  function start(){
    items=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.gs-reveal'));
    if(!items.length)return;
    window.addEventListener('scroll',queue,{passive:true});
    window.addEventListener('resize',queue);
    /* a tab that loads in the background gets no rAF ticks and no scroll events, so the
       first pass runs synchronously and visibilitychange re-runs it on the way back */
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',queue);
    pass();
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',start);
  else start();
})();
</script>

<style class="gs-fixes">
/* Fix round 1 (BUGS A2/A5): cosmetics moved out of meta/overrides.json — overrides are a
   single client-side pass at DOMContentLoaded, so they flash un-applied on slow mobile and
   never reach innerHTML-rebuilt nodes. Rule order and selectors follow the WP-F1 table.
   v7-skin round (design/SKIN_V7.md): rule VALUES recolored to the donor palette
   (research/donor-v7.html) — green #3F6B39, deep #2C4E28, wash #DCEBC4, bg #F4F8EE;
   rule 8 added (hardcoded #194536 at order-funnel.css:545). Structure otherwise frozen. */
/* 1 */ .sf-notice{display:none}
/* 2 */ :root{--sf-notice-h:0px}
/* 3 - P0 contrast fix: template painted white text on lime (1.31:1).
       .sf-header.scrolled is (0,2,0), so it is covered explicitly. #2C4E28 on #fff = 9.43. */
.sf-header,.sf-header.scrolled{background:#fff;color:#2C4E28}
/* 4 - ID-scoped: the funnel injects its CSS in-body, so ties are not safe.
       --of-lime consumers are of-duration__gift (green-on-wash 4.96 AA at 11px/700) and
       of-promo__input:focus border. --of-bg #F4F8EE keeps #6B6B6B at 4.95 and #B42318
       at 6.11 - both still AA (SKIN_V7 §1). */
#orderFunnel{--of-green:#3F6B39;--of-green-d:#2C4E28;--of-lime:#DCEBC4;--of-bg:#F4F8EE}
/* 5 - background shorthand, not background-color: it must clear the gradient */
#orderFunnel .of-offer{background:#2C4E28}
/* 6 */ #orderFunnel .of-dd__gift{color:#2C4E28}
/* 7 - static CSS also reaches the nodes applyPeriod() rebuilds (the A2 fix) */
#orderFunnel .of-gift-accent{color:#2C4E28}
/* 8 - v7: order-funnel.css:545 hardcodes #194536 on #eef7ee; repoint to the skin deep.
       #2C4E28 on #eef7ee = 8.9, PASS. */
#orderFunnel .of-prefs__preview{color:#2C4E28}
</style>

<style class="gs-restyle">
/* Fix round 2 - visual refresh band 06 (design/VISUAL_REFRESH.md §3).
   Every selector is #orderFunnel-scoped: funnel internals are single-class (0,1,0)
   and the funnel injects its CSS in-body, so ID-scoping (1,x,0) wins independent of
   source order. This band must sort strictly between 05- and 10-.
   No content: here (band 09 owns pseudo-content, and stays droppable);
   nothing here changes layout mode, geometry or visibility of a functional node. */

/* T1 - type continuity (B8): .of declares font-family exactly once
   (order-funnel.css:25), so this single rule rebrands all five screens.
   Beats .of (0,1,0) with (1,0,0). */
#orderFunnel{font-family:"Museo Sans Cyrl",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,Arial,sans-serif}
/* T2 - money and titles in the skin display face (v7: donor sets 800/tight system sans;
   Loos Wide retired from the funnel with the skin round - SKIN_V7 §2) */
#orderFunnel .of-plan__num,
#orderFunnel .of-mbar__val,
#orderFunnel .of-total__sum,
#orderFunnel .of-fcard__total-val,
#orderFunnel .of-head__title{font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
/* T3 - money prominence (B1): the running total shipped at 16px system font */
#orderFunnel .of-mbar__val{font-size:21px}
#orderFunnel .of-total__sum{font-size:22px}
#orderFunnel .of-plan__perday{font-size:12px}
/* The funnel has an @media(min-width:900px) twin (order-funnel.css:1187) setting
   of-hero__title 44px and of-plan__price 22px. Media queries add NO specificity, so an
   unconditional ID rule wins there too and would shrink both on desktop. Scope to mobile. */
@media (max-width:899px){
  #orderFunnel .of-plan__price{font-size:15px}
  #orderFunnel .of-hero__title{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.02em}
}
/* That same desktop twin hardcodes color:#888 (3.54:1) on of-plan__perday, bypassing
   --of-muted, so C1 never reaches it. (1,1,0) beats the twin's (0,1,0). */
#orderFunnel .of-plan__perday{color:#6B6B6B}

/* C - contrast repairs (P0 - this is price text on the payment path).
   of-dd__price is the period's PRICE at 13px on --of-muted #888 = 3.54:1.
   #6B6B6B = 5.33 on white, 4.68 on #f0f0f0, 4.67 on #EAF3DF - passes everywhere it sits.
   All 13 var(--of-muted) consumers in order-funnel.css are color:, so C1 is safe. */
#orderFunnel{--of-muted:#6B6B6B}                                 /* C1 - fixes every consumer at once */
#orderFunnel .of-hint{color:#6B6B6B}                             /* C2 - was #aaa, 2.32 */
#orderFunnel .of-step.is-pending .of-step__title{color:#6B6B6B}  /* C3 - was #aaa, 2.32 */
#orderFunnel .of-err{color:#B42318}                              /* C4 - was #e53935 4.23; now 6.57 */
#orderFunnel .of-pay__hint{color:#6B6B6B}                        /* C5 - literal #888, not the var */

/* S - selection is a fill, never a lone border (B4). #DCEBC4 = v7 spring (SKIN_V7 §1). */
#orderFunnel .of-plan.is-selected{background:#DCEBC4}            /* S1 - v7 spring wash */
#orderFunnel .of-dd__opt.is-selected{background:#DCEBC4}         /* S2 - was #f3f9f0 */
#orderFunnel .of-menucal__time.is-selected{background:#DCEBC4;color:#2C4E28;border-color:#2C4E28} /* S3 */
#orderFunnel .of-weekday.is-on{color:#2C4E28}                    /* S4 - was #2f7d33; 9.1 on #f2fbdf */

/* O1 - offer badge (B7), v7: spring chip, deep ink = 7.51 AAA at any size */
#orderFunnel .of-offer__badge{background:#DCEBC4;color:#2C4E28}

/* E1 - payment encapsulation (B5): the money card reads as a vault, not a list item */
#orderFunnel .of-total{border:1.5px solid #d7ddd8;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08)}

/* D - promo de-emphasis (Baymard exit-ramp): quiet, still discoverable, still functional */
#orderFunnel .of-promo__input{background:#f7f7f7;border-color:transparent}
#orderFunnel .of-promo__btn{background:transparent;color:#2C4E28;border:1.5px solid #d7ddd8}
</style>

<style class="gs-surcharge">
/* Fix round 2 - WP-R2 / SURCHARGE_STRATEGY R1.
   The funnel ships the replacement surcharge as an error: order-funnel.css:1340
   paints .of-subnote #e53935 on #fdecea = 3.70:1 at 13px/600, a WCAG AA failure.
   The charge is real and stays fully visible at the same size, in the same place,
   at the same moment - only the semantics change from error to information.
   v7 skin recolor (SKIN_V7 §1): #2C4E28 on #DCEBC4 is 7.51:1 - more legible than
   what it replaces. ID-scoped (1,1,0) so it beats the funnel's own (0,1,0) rule
   regardless of the order in which the funnel injects its in-body stylesheet. */
#orderFunnel .of-subnote{color:#2C4E28;background:#DCEBC4}
</style>

<style class="gs-prefs">
/* WP-R3 — prefs limit: the missing disabled state.
   order-funnel.js:917 sets MAX_PREFS = 3; enforcePrefLimit() (:920-925) does
   `if (!i.checked) i.disabled = checked >= MAX_PREFS` on every [data-of-pref].
   order-funnel.css ships no matching disabled rule, so once three are checked
   «Без десерта» still looks exactly like a live option and does nothing.
   This band supplies the missing feedback only — the 3-preference cap is
   Olive's business rule and is not touched, raised or bypassed here.
   ID-scoped throughout: .of-* rules are single-class and the funnel injects
   its CSS in-body, so source order can never be relied on. */
#orderFunnel .of-prefs__opt input[data-of-pref]:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
#orderFunnel .of-prefs__opt input[data-of-pref]:disabled+span{color:#9E9E9E}
/* Progressive enhancement only. Carries cursor, never the colour or opacity,
   so the two rules above still deliver the full state where :has() is absent —
   and a :has() failure can never leave a working control looking disabled. */
#orderFunnel .of-prefs__opt:has(>input[data-of-pref]:disabled){cursor:not-allowed}
</style>

<style class="gs-tapfix">
/* Fix round 3 - two funnel ergonomics repairs. Band sorts between 08-prefs and
   09-pseudo, i.e. strictly between 05- and 10-: after the frozen round-1 rules,
   still before the funnel markup. Both selectors are #orderFunnel-scoped (1,x,0),
   so they beat order-funnel.css's single-class rules independent of source order.
   No content:, no display/visibility/position - those red lines belong to 09 and
   to the restyle contract. */

/* 1 - scroll anchoring. Every screen transition calls root.scrollIntoView
   ({block:'start'}) (order-funnel.js:177), which parks the funnel top flush with the
   viewport top - straight under the ~50px fixed site header, so the funnel's own
   topbar (back button + step label) lands behind the chrome. scroll-margin-top makes
   the browser stop 64px earlier; it affects scrolling only, never layout or paint. */
#orderFunnel{scroll-margin-top:64px}

/* 2 - calendar tap targets. .of-cal__day ships 34x34px (order-funnel.css:953-965),
   under the 44px minimum for a touch target; the delivery-date grid is the densest
   tap surface in the funnel. (1,1,0) beats the incumbent (0,1,0). max-width:100%
   guards narrow viewports: .of-cal__week is a 7-column 1fr grid (css:941-944), so a
   column is ~47px at 390px - 44px fits - and below that the cell shrinks to the
   column instead of overflowing the row. The selector covers both span.is-off and
   button[data-cal-day], so every cell in a week keeps the same height. It is
   unconditional, so it also overrides the desktop twin (css:1273, 38x38 at
   >=900px) - media queries add no specificity; 44px there is still correct. */
#orderFunnel .of-cal__day{width:44px;max-width:100%;height:44px}
</style>

<style class="gs-pseudo">
/* Fix round 2 - WP-R4: the ONLY CSS-generated copy of the round, isolated on
   purpose. Dropping this band (rm landing/sections/09-pseudo.json + re-assemble)
   removes every CSS-generated word and touches nothing else. Trade-off accepted
   knowingly: generated copy is not selectable, not translatable, invisible to the
   overrides validator, and fails silently if Olive renames a funnel class.
   All selectors #orderFunnel-scoped (1,x,0) - beats order-funnel.css (0,1,0)
   independent of source order. Markup anchors verified in research/preview-v1133.html. */

/* P - progress labels (VISUAL_REFRESH §3-P). The 4 of-topbars (render :303 preview,
   :476 prefs, :671 delivery, :842 checkout) contain only .of-back; .of-topbar__title
   occurs 0 times in the render, so ::after is the only label and collides with nothing.
   .of-topbar is a flex row (order-funnel.css:136) -> ::after becomes a flex item;
   margin-right balances .of-back (36px, css:153). #6B6B6B on --of-bg #F4F8EE (v7 skin, 05-style rule 4) = 4.95.
   The menu screen has no topbar, so step 1 is deliberately unlabelled. */
#orderFunnel .of-topbar::after{flex:1;text-align:center;margin-right:36px;
  font:600 13px/1.3 "Museo Sans Cyrl",Arial,sans-serif;color:#6B6B6B}
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="preview"]  .of-topbar::after{content:"Шаг 2 из 4"}
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="prefs"]    .of-topbar::after{content:"Настройка меню"}
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="delivery"] .of-topbar::after{content:"Шаг 3 из 4"}
#orderFunnel .of-screen[data-screen="checkout"] .of-topbar::after{content:"Шаг 4 из 4"}

/* E2 - processor line under the pay button (VISUAL_REFRESH §3-E). .of-total is
   a flex column (css:1148) and its last child is the pay button
   (render :928), so ::after lands beneath it. True claim: the render loads
   epay.homebank.kz/payform/payment-api.js (:1460) and says the same in the FAQ (:1199)
   and trust strip (:988). E1 (border/shadow on .of-total itself) belongs to WP-R1. */
#orderFunnel .of-total::after{content:"Платёж обрабатывает Halyk Bank ePay";
  text-align:center;font:500 12px/1.4 "Museo Sans Cyrl",Arial,sans-serif;color:#6B6B6B}

/* R2 - surcharge explainer (SURCHARGE_STRATEGY R2). This is the one place where CSS
   content is not merely convenient: order-funnel.js:742-752 rewrites the note's
   textContent on every recalc and toggles classList only, so a text override is wiped
   and static CSS survives. Node: <div class="of-subnote d-none" data-replace-note>
   (render :450) - .d-none hides the node outright (css:802), so the explainer is
   hidden with the note and appears only when a real surcharge exists. Basis wording is
   the funnel's own: full = periodDays + periodGift (js:759). #194536 on WP-R2's
   #EAF3DF wash = 9.45. No numbers - CSS cannot compute them. */
#orderFunnel .of-subnote::after{
  content:"Это разница в цене заменённых блюд — за все дни подписки, включая подарочные. Уберите или измените предпочтения — сумма пересчитается.";
  display:block;margin-top:4px;font-weight:400;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35;color:#194536}

/* Prefs limit hint - the explanatory half of WP-R3's disabled state (WORK_PACKAGES
   WP-R4.4). Container <div class="of-prefs" data-prefs> (render :518) is
   a flex column (css:482), so ::after sits under the last group.
   Inputs are <input type="checkbox" data-of-pref value="N"> nested in
   label.of-prefs__opt (render :525-529), so the descendant :has() guard fires exactly
   when enforcePrefLimit (js:917-924) has disabled the unchecked boxes, i.e. at 3
   selected. Degrades to nothing without :has(); WP-R3's grey-out does not depend on it.
   #6B6B6B >= 4.68 on every ground it can sit on. */
#orderFunnel .of-prefs:has(input[data-of-pref]:disabled)::after{
  content:"Максимум — 3 предпочтения. Чтобы выбрать другое, снимите одно из выбранных.";
  display:block;margin-top:10px;font:400 13px/1.4 "Museo Sans Cyrl",Arial,sans-serif;
  color:#6B6B6B}

/* Code-not-arrived dead end (audit T1) - palliative only. Checkout step 2 offers a
   single [data-verify-code] button: order-funnel.js has no resend and no change-phone
   path, so a lost WhatsApp code ends the order with nothing on screen to do next.
   This adds the one available exit - the real business WhatsApp, +7 700 870-26-26
   (footer wa.me/77008702626, render :1479; same number in 20-trust.json).
   Node: <div class="of-step is-pending" data-step="2"> (render :840) -> .of-step__body
   (:848) is a flex column (order-funnel.css:858-865), so ::after becomes the last flex
   item, under the «Подтвердить» button. .of-step:not(.is-active) .of-step__body
   {display:none} (css:867) hides the body outright, so the hint can only appear while
   step 2 is the active step - never next to steps 1 or 3. Copy is state-independent and
   carries no numbers. #6B6B6B on the white checkout card = 5.33. */
#orderFunnel [data-step="2"] .of-step__body::after{
  content:"Код не пришёл? Напишите нам в WhatsApp: +7 700 870-26-26";
  font:400 13px/1.4 "Museo Sans Cyrl",Arial,sans-serif;color:#6B6B6B}

/* ── LK round: configurator labels + the folded trust strip ─────────────────
   Copy generated here rather than in 09z-configurator so this band stays the single

   else). Geometry for the same nodes lives in 09z. */

/* «Продолжительность» heading over the duration chips. [data-pdd].of-dd is a flex

   top without touching a single node. */
#orderFunnel [data-pdd].of-dd::before{content:"Продолжительность";order:0;

   window.OLIVE_PRICING every plan halves its per-day price on periods 3 and 4
   (10000->5000, 11000->5500, 12000->6000, 13000->6500) because the gift days double the
   days of food. Periods 1 and 2 carry no gift days and are deliberately unbadged.
   #2C4E28 on the chip grounds (#fff / #DCEBC4) = 9.43 / 7.51. */
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt[data-period-id="3"]::after,
#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt[data-period-id="4"]::after{

#orderFunnel [data-pdd] .of-dd__opt.is-selected[data-period-id="4"]::after{background:#fff}

/* Trust strip folded into the configurator (the user's «fold the proof into the funnel»
   call when 20-trust / 55-quality were dropped). It sits directly under the calorie grid,
   i.e. at the first commitment point. .of-plans is a 2-col grid in 09z, so the pseudo
   element must span both columns or it would occupy a single cell.
   Claims are the ones the retired quality block carried (Olive's published ISO 22000 and
   Halal certification) plus the processor the page actually loads
   (epay.homebank.kz/payform/payment-api.js). #4E5748 on #F4F8EE = 7.2. */
#orderFunnel .of-plans::after{
  content:"ISO 22000 · Сертификат Халал · оплата картой через Halyk Bank ePay";
  grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:14px 8px 2px;
  font:600 13px/1.45 "Museo Sans Cyrl",Arial,sans-serif;color:#4E5748}

   .program-day chip lists + a right-hand live menu column + a floating summary bar).

   CSS ONLY, and every selector is #orderFunnel-scoped. Hard limit 3 stands: no node is
   added, removed, renamed or reparented, no id/name/data-* is touched, and no click
   handler is intercepted — order-funnel.js keeps driving exactly the same DOM it shipped.
   Specificity: funnel internals are single-class (0,1,0) and the funnel injects its CSS
   in-body, so ID-scoping (1,x,0) wins independent of source order. This band sorts last
   among ours, so it also settles ties with 05/06/07/08.

   visibility, and clicks on [data-duration] are bound to the options themselves

   Scoped to [data-pdd] on purpose: the checkout dropdown ([data-cdays]) keeps its
   popover behaviour. */

  text-transform:none;color:#20271A;padding:10px 2px 6px}

   (order-funnel.js:601-605) still toggles .d-none, which no longer decides visibility. A

   shows the selection, so the dead control is hidden. Its [data-pdd-label] node still
   exists and still receives applyPeriod()'s text — the summary bar in 80-orderbar reads
   it, and nothing in the funnel depends on it being painted. */

#orderFunnel [data-pdd] > .of-dd__menu{order:2;display:grid!important;

/* «Дата первой доставки» + предпочтения — LK card row */
#orderFunnel .of-frow{margin-top:10px;gap:10px}
#orderFunnel .of-fcard{border-radius:16px;border-color:#E3E8DE}

/* the live menu column — LK «actual-menu-list» */
#orderFunnel .of-day__title{font-size:19px;letter-spacing:-.02em}
#orderFunnel .of-day__sum{font-size:13px;color:#4E5748}

/* ── the floating summary bar (LK .summary-container) ───────────────────

   one bar is ever visible and both wear this geometry: detached, rounded, floating. */
#orderFunnel .of-mbar{left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;bottom:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
  flex-direction:row;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:22px;
  border-top:none;background:#20271A;

items.a: Подарочные дни действуют на тарифах 14 и 30 дней: платите за 14 — питаетесь 28, платите за 30 — питаетесь 60. Они начисляются автоматически, промокод не нужен, и день выходит вдвое дешевле, чем на пробном тарифе. Тарифы 1 и 5 дней — пробные: подарочных дней в них нет, день стоит полную цену — от 10 000 ₸.

В Алматы есть зона бесплатной доставки; в остальных зонах — от 600 до 2 100 ₸ за каждый день доставки. Стоимость считается за все дни заказа, включая подарочные — блюда мы привозим и в эти дни. Точную сумму доставки за весь заказ покажем сразу после проверки адреса, ещё до оплаты.
Банковской картой онлайн: платёж обрабатывает процессинг Halyk Bank (ePay). Телефон подтверждается кодом в WhatsApp, состав и сумма заказа видны до оплаты.

items.q: Что за «Доплата за замены» при выборе предпочтений?
items.a: Когда вы исключаете продукты (например, выпечку или белый сахар), мы заменяем блюда меню на подходящие. Доплата — это разница в цене блюд по меню. Она считается за каждый день доставки, включая подарочные дни, потому что блюда мы привозим и в эти дни. Если все блюда подходят, доплаты нет. Заменённые блюда отмечены в меню, сумма видна до оплаты, а если убрать предпочтение — доплата пересчитается или исчезнет.
Четыре плана: 1 200 и 1 500 ккал (4 блюда в день), 1 800 ккал (5 блюд) и 2 500 ккал (6 блюд). Всего в меню 297 блюд, КБЖУ рассчитаны для каждого.
Блюда готовятся на собственном производстве в Алматы; продукция регулярно проверяется в независимых лабораториях, на всех этапах работает холодная цепь хранения.

Да, замена блюд доступна прямо при оформлении заказа — в меню на каждый день. Если выбранное блюдо дороже того, что было в рационе, разница добавится к заказу — как и при выборе предпочтений; сумма всегда видна до оплаты.
